newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to creep down towards 129.32.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to creep down towards 129.32.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF will head towards support around 129.32 on Tuesday but will not be in serious trouble unless they break trendline support further below, analysts said.
"In the short run, I think there is further downside expected," Simon Mattholie, proprietary trader at Deutsche Bank in London, said.
Notionnel futures were quoted at 129.72 at 0918 GMT, down 0.16 from Friday. The market was closed on Monday for a holiday.
Mattholie said the market would first aim for 129.32, the low on May 6.

Mattholie said the main trendline support comes in around 129.08, drawn off April 4 and April 25 lows, but not including gaps and holidays. Including those, trendline support comes in this session around 129.21 on daily charts, analysts said.
Technical analysts at Chase in London said Friday's volatile action has established a key reversal day as well as putting in a double top formation in place on intra-day charts.

"This break lower also confirms 130.76 as a corrective (b) wave top and we would expect a (c) wave decline to start developing with further losses testing support at 129.70 and 129.66 initially," they said.
Chase was referring to Elliott Wave theory which holds markets move in five alternate waves one way followed by a-b-c three-wave correction.

Mattholie said if the Bunds manage to hold their gains notionnel could try and rebound but resistance comes in around 129.86, the low from May 16. Above there it would target the intra-day lows of May 15 at 130.20.
"But I think gains above that would be fairly difficult to make," he said.
At the short end, June Pibor were quoted at 96.51, down one basis point at 0902 GMT.
